intrebari.intrebare: Cinderella's stepsisters treated her with great ______. (KIND)
intrebari.explicatie: un- + kind + -ness: noun meaning 'lack of kindness'.

intrebari.intrebare: The miller's boast that his daughter could spin straw into gold was utterly ______. (BELIEVE)
intrebari.explicatie: un- + believe + -able. The final -e of 'believe' is dropped before -able.

intrebari.intrebare: The birds ate Hansel's breadcrumbs, so the path home became ______. (TRACE)
intrebari.explicatie: After a soft 'c' the -e is kept before -able: trace → traceable → untraceable.

intrebari.intrebare: The queen could not bear Snow White's ______ beauty. (COMPARE)
intrebari.explicatie: 'Comparable' takes the prefix in-: incomparable = so great that nothing compares with it.

intrebari.intrebare: The gingerbread house was completely ______ to the hungry children. (RESIST)
intrebari.explicatie: in- becomes ir- before 'r'; 'resist' takes the suffix -ible, not -able.

intrebari.intrebare: The prince searched the kingdom for the ______ of the glass slipper. (OWN)
intrebari.explicatie: The suffix -er forms a noun for a person: own → owner.

intrebari.intrebare: The wicked queen was famous for her ______. (VAIN)
intrebari.explicatie: The noun from 'vain' is 'vanity' — note the spelling change.

intrebari.intrebare: The first little pig built his house of straw rather ______. (CARE)
intrebari.explicatie: We need an adverb that describes how he built: care + -less + -ly.

intrebari.intrebare: Rumpelstiltskin flew into a rage when the queen guessed his name ______. (CORRECT)
intrebari.explicatie: An adverb is needed; the story tells us she guessed right, so 'correctly'.

intrebari.intrebare: The giant's ______ shook the whole castle. (ANGRY)
intrebari.explicatie: The noun related to 'angry' is 'anger'.

intrebari.intrebare: The fairy godmother granted Cinderella's wish with great ______. (GENEROUS)
intrebari.explicatie: generous → generosity: the -u- disappears before -ity.

intrebari.intrebare: The woodcutter's ______ saved Little Red Riding Hood. (BRAVE)
intrebari.explicatie: brave + -ery forms the noun 'bravery'.

intrebari.intrebare: Under the spell, Sleeping Beauty lay ______ for a hundred years. (MOVE)
intrebari.explicatie: un- + moving: 'not moving'.

intrebari.intrebare: The princess felt deeply ______ when the frog reminded her of her promise. (COMFORT)
intrebari.explicatie: un- + comfort + -able. ('Discomfort' is a noun, but 'discomfortable' does not exist.)

intrebari.intrebare: The witch's ______ to eat the children horrified Gretel. (INTEND)
intrebari.explicatie: intend → intention: the -d- changes to -t- before -ion.

intrebari.intrebare: The emperor's new clothes were, of course, completely ______. (VISIBLE)
intrebari.explicatie: 'Visible' takes the prefix in-: invisible.

intrebari.intrebare: The whole kingdom celebrated the princess's ______ to the prince. (MARRY)
intrebari.explicatie: marry → marriage: -y changes to -i- before -age.

intrebari.intrebare: The dwarfs were ______ when they found Snow White asleep in one of their beds. (AMAZE)
intrebari.explicatie: -ed adjectives describe how a person feels; -ing adjectives describe what causes the feeling.

intrebari.intrebare: The story of the Ugly Duckling has a rather ______ ending. (EXPECT)
intrebari.explicatie: un- + expected: 'not expected' (it describes the ending, so the -ed form).

intrebari.intrebare: Overnight, the beanstalk grew to an ______ height. (ORDINARY)
intrebari.explicatie: extra- (beyond) + ordinary = very unusual.

intrebari.intrebare: Little Red Riding Hood was ______ of the danger hiding in the woods. (AWARE)
intrebari.explicatie: 'Aware' takes the negative prefix un-.

intrebari.intrebare: The king promised a great reward for the ______ of the dragon. (DESTROY)
intrebari.explicatie: The noun from 'destroy' is irregular: destruction.

intrebari.intrebare: The wolf ______ the little pigs by pretending to be friendly. (LEAD)
intrebari.explicatie: mis- means 'wrongly': mislead (past: misled) = make someone believe something false.

intrebari.intrebare: The poor shoemaker was ______ to pay his rent until the elves helped him. (ABLE)
intrebari.explicatie: un- + able = not able. ('Disable' is a verb with a different meaning.)

intrebari.intrebare: The fox's ______ fooled the Gingerbread Man. (CLEVER)
intrebari.explicatie: clever + -ness forms the noun.

intrebari.intrebare: At first the Beast's castle seemed ______, but it was full of magic. (INHABIT)
intrebari.explicatie: un- + inhabited = with nobody living there.

intrebari.intrebare: The princess spent a ______ night because of the pea under her mattresses. (SLEEP)
intrebari.explicatie: -less means 'without': a sleepless night = a night without sleep.

intrebari.intrebare: Jack's mother was ______ when he exchanged the cow for some beans. (FURY)
intrebari.explicatie: fury → furious: -y changes to -i- before -ous.

intrebari.intrebare: The little mermaid made a ______ decision to give up her voice. (DANGER)
intrebari.explicatie: danger + -ous forms the adjective.

intrebari.intrebare: The magic porridge pot produced an ______ amount of porridge. (END)
intrebari.explicatie: -less means 'without': endless = without an end.

intrebari.intrebare: The golden goose brought its owner great ______. (HAPPY)
intrebari.explicatie: happy → happiness: -y changes to -i- before -ness.

intrebari.intrebare: The stepmother's ______ towards Snow White grew stronger every day. (JEALOUS)
intrebari.explicatie: jealous + -y forms the noun 'jealousy'.

intrebari.intrebare: Goldilocks ______ walked into the bears' house without knocking. (POLITE)
intrebari.explicatie: 'Polite' takes im-; we need an adverb (-ly) to describe how she walked in.

intrebari.intrebare: The prince ______ the wicked spell with a kiss. (DO)
intrebari.explicatie: un- reverses an action: undo (past: undid) a spell = cancel it.

intrebari.intrebare: The ______ of the twelve dancing princesses every night puzzled the king. (APPEAR)
intrebari.explicatie: dis- + appear + -ance: the act of disappearing.

intrebari.intrebare: The princess found the slimy frog rather ______. (ATTRACT)
intrebari.explicatie: un- + attract + -ive.

intrebari.intrebare: The tortoise's ______ helped him win the race against the hare. (PATIENT)
intrebari.explicatie: Adjectives in -ent usually form nouns in -ence: patient → patience.

intrebari.intrebare: Aladdin's lamp had ______ powers. (MAGIC)
intrebari.explicatie: magic + -al forms the adjective 'magical'.

intrebari.intrebare: The giant fell asleep, and Jack escaped ______. (NOTICE)
intrebari.explicatie: un- + noticed = without being noticed.

intrebari.intrebare: The ending of 'Cinderella' shows that ______ is always rewarded. (GOOD)
intrebari.explicatie: good + -ness forms the noun.
